name: Star Wars
grading_rules: Canon = stated on a canon Wookieepedia page (titles WITHOUT '/Legends'). Legends = only supported by a page whose title ends in '/Legends' (the pre-2014 Expanded Universe Lucasfilm rebranded as Legends). Conflicting = canon sources disagree. Fan theory = popular interpretation or speculation the evidence does not confirm (or real-world inspiration claims that only appear as creator commentary). Unsupported = no evidence card says it. Grade canon STATUS, not paraphrase: hedged or multiply-told events are Conflicting. Interpretation = history-to-fiction parallels and narrator framing.
